title: Q-WORKERS-214: core/access: owner asks for access that exists are refused in code (access preflight)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** file:workers/core/access/access.test.js
**Status:** open

Moved from ultrastable/workers#214 (workers repo archived; code now under workers/ here, issues disabled on this repo).

Owner role: operations. Done check: a gate card about access, a permission, a credential or an install cannot reach an open state unless the access preflight proved the capability missing on every route; the preflight runs each tick and in CI of every tenant. Closing probe: `node --test core/access/*.test.js` passes and `core/access/cli.mjs` exits 0 in the tenant CI.

Why: agents repeatedly asked the owner for access that was already granted (Cloudflare Workers & Pages GitHub app on both orgs, Cloudflare credentials reaching both accounts). Words did not stop it, so the rule is a database trigger.
